Thus each case’s post-edit result—and its purported pass rate—rests on a single run.","status":"fail"}},"passed":false,"rationale":"The revision is focused, directive, and observable, and it correctly requires a full-suite rerun with fresh runners and separate judges plus before/after reporting.
